items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: The name 'Melee' is only used by the interviewer to address the interviewee (Emile Barnes). There is no mention of a separate person named Melee, nor any relationship described involving a third party with that name.

ctx.x: That was a little before the First War. That's long, yeah, that's long before the First War. Yeah, because, oh yeah. Yeah, that's long before the First War. Because when I was going away, I remember Joe, I was playing, you can go, you go, but crying ain't gonna bring you back. And he said to me, he said, goodbye old boy, I'll never forget that. I said, you're gone now, but I'll be here when you come back. I didn't tell it to count. The First World War, that's a good way to pull that.

I keep forgetting when you said you were born, Melee. I'm just trying to place it with your age. When you said you were going in the district, you were 17. That would be about what, about 1910 or something like that?
Yeah, about that, because I'm only 92.
